source.title: M1.2 — CORE: Internal Aggregated Buy List & Offline Purchasing
source.body:
# First-release sourcing reality — OWNER DECISION 13 Nov 2026

**Use an INTERNAL AGGREGATED BUY LIST, not a fake supplier account.** ShinaCare has no registered/responding suppliers in the active MVP. Staff obtain all requested goods from external market contacts manually; external buying/contact/negotiation happens entirely **outside ShinaCare software**. **Existing supplier/Purchase/RFQ/broadcast implementation must be preserved intact when present**, but hidden/inactive and NOT required to run or pass first-release checks. Do not rebuild it, delete it or pretend internal staff are supplier identities.

## MVP requirement: Hub/Admin "قائمة المشتريات" / Buy List

* Read actual eligible confirmed COD order **line items** from backend and show exact canonical product, SKU/variant/size, quantity needed **summed across orders**, number of customer orders, linked order IDs and optional timing/delivery urgency. Example: Order #101: A×2 + B×1; Order #102: A×3 + C×1 → **A×5, B×1, C×1**.
* It must be impossible to mix variants or sizes (A 50 ml versus A 100 ml remain distinct). Ignore cancelled/test/invalid orders; quantities reflect active, not-yet-satisfied demand. Do not invent stock or supplier pricing. Show unpurchased remaining quantities, not always total lifetime order quantities.
* One internal authorized user marks purchased/received quantity manually and can mark unavailable/partially sourced. This is an **internal operational marker only**, NOT a supplier confirmation/PO. Status integrates with existing Hub pack/dispatch workflow and customer support/recovery; preserve the commercial customer order snapshot and COD amount.
* Provide a straightforward, printable/copyable purchase summary for taking outside the system. If product purchase cost is already tracked, allow actual cost entry when known, without making settlement or cost accounting a blocker. Do not require invoices, supplier identity, RFQ, supplier offer, supplier response or allocated POs for the first release.
* **Concurrency/idempotency:** prevent two staff from counting the same item twice; refresh demand when orders change, separate already-acquired vs remaining, and handle cancelled order/shortage while a shopping run is open. Reuse existing schema/Hub primitives where possible, minimal changes.
* Roles: Hub or authorized Admin can view/update the buy list. Drivers/suppliers cannot access internal list. Show real empty/loading/error states; no mock values.

## Release-proof scenario

Two orders containing overlapping real product A and separate B/C → consolidated Buy List A×5/B×1/C×1 → copy/print → obtain them manually offline → mark acquired (or partial/unavailable) → Hub pack/hand-off → Driver delivery/COD → customer tracking. Negative: cancelled order excluded, wrong variant not combined, retry doesn't double count, two concurrent staff see consistent outstanding quantities, insufficient quantity results in safe customer exception.

## Future phases (NOT 20 Nov 2026 blockers)

* **Phase 2 — Supplier broadcast:** when formal suppliers are onboarded, send shared requests to multiple supplier accounts; they may respond concurrently/independently with full/partial/reject and actionable line items; no all-suppliers waiting barrier, safe allocation and response expiry.
* **Phase 3 — Supplier APIs:** external supplier availability/price/order acknowledgement integrations, secure adapters, reconciliation, mapping and retries.
  Old supplier/Purchasing modules can remain behind roles/routes/feature flags, but must not interfere with Phase 1 workflow. Do not mark them Done or rewrite them as part of MVP.

**Done only when:** current HEAD full order→buy list→offline-acquired marker→Hub/Delivery route passes with real persisted data and negative cases. This issue is strictly internal purchasing aggregation, not supplier onboarding, purchase-order automation or procurement provider integration.
